tiger_sprint.input: Use the equipped Tiger Sprint sword-skill input in the chosen stance.
tiger_sprint.description: Replaces the game-selected Tiger Sprint sheathe/Iai entry after Nioh accepts its skill and loadout conditions.

dodge_attack.input: Dodge, then press Strong attack / Triangle / Y in the chosen stance.
dodge_attack.description: Replaces the selected dodge attack; ordinary standing attacks remain native.

heavy_attack.input: Press Strong attack / Triangle / Y in the chosen stance.
heavy_attack.description: Replaces that stance's normal heavy opener. Any covers all three stances and uses three native slots.

light_attack.input: Press Quick attack / Square / X in Low, Mid, or High stance.
light_attack.description: Replaces that stance's normal quick opener. Any covers all three stances and uses three native slots; running, dodging and stance-switch actions stay separate.

guard_light.input: Hold Guard / L1 / LB, then press Quick attack / Square / X.
guard_light.description: Replaces the game-selected guard-and-quick sword skill in the chosen stance.

high_heavy_followup.input: After a High-stance heavy, hold Guard / L1 / LB and press Quick attack / Square / X in its follow-up window.
high_heavy_followup.description: Replaces the selected High-heavy follow-up, not the opening heavy attack.

okatsu.charged_rush.input: Use the input and stance where you assign this single attack.
okatsu.charged_rush.description: Okatsu's forward charged sword rush adapted as a William action; it is separate from the optional grapple finisher.

okatsu.leaping_slash.input: Use the input and stance where you assign this single attack.
okatsu.leaping_slash.description: Okatsu's leaping sword slash adapted as one action rather than a multi-phase string.

okatsu.action_0c61.input: Enable Okatsu kicking string and assign this opener. Hold a controller chord through the later hits; a tap plays only the opener.
okatsu.action_0c61.description: Opening hit of Okatsu's quick/kick sequence. Hold the input through the kicks, flip, and grab attempt.

okatsu.action_0c62.input: Automatic continuation after Okatsu's opening hit.
okatsu.action_0c62.description: Second phase of the kicking sequence; this speed setting affects this phase only.

okatsu.action_0c63.input: Automatic continuation after Okatsu's second phase.
okatsu.action_0c63.description: Third phase of the kicking sequence before the flip/grab route.

okatsu.action_0c69.input: Reached when Okatsu's kicking sequence accepts its grab route.
okatsu.action_0c69.description: Flip/grab phase; paired contact and the target reaction remain separate game conditions.

okatsu.action_0361.input: Internal paired continuation after Okatsu's grab; no independent button.
okatsu.action_0361.description: Grab finisher used only after the paired grapple condition succeeds.

jin_hayabusa.action_0bc0.input: Trigger the assigned input in its stance; the next two heavy strikes follow this opener.
jin_hayabusa.action_0bc0.description: Opening strike of Jin's three-part heavy sword string C.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c6c.input: Automatic second strike after Jin heavy string C opens.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c6c.description: Second attack of heavy string C; tune this phase independently of the opener.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c6d.input: Automatic third strike after Jin heavy string C continues.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c6d.description: Final attack of heavy string C and its exit into native recovery.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c6e.input: Trigger the assigned input in its stance; two cyclone strikes follow this opener.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c6e.description: Opening strike of Jin's three-part cyclone heavy string.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c6f.input: Second strike of the cyclone string, or its own reviewed native override slot.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c6f.description: Jin's second cyclone slash. A direct override selects this phase; a full string reaches it after the opener.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c70.input: Automatic final strike after the cyclone string's second attack.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c70.description: Finishing cyclone slash and recovery phase of Jin's heavy string.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c79.input: Use the assigned source in its stance; a Hold Triangle / Y slot requires holding Strong attack.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c79.description: Jin's standalone launcher. It lifts but does not request the paired Izuna Drop.

jin_hayabusa.izuna_drop.input: Use the assigned source in its stance; the paired drop needs valid airborne target contact.
jin_hayabusa.izuna_drop.description: Launcher plus Izuna Drop graph. Contact, target ownership and camera conditions decide whether the paired follow-up can run.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c7a.input: Automatic airborne contact phase after the Izuna launcher reaches a target.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c7a.description: Izuna bridge from the launcher into paired lift; it has no independent binding.

jin_hayabusa.action_03b2.input: Automatic paired lift after Izuna contact.
jin_hayabusa.action_03b2.description: Internal synchronized attacker/victim lift; its paired timing stays native.

jin_hayabusa.action_03b4.input: Automatic airborne loop after the Izuna lift.
jin_hayabusa.action_03b4.description: Internal synchronized midair continuation of the Izuna sequence.

jin_hayabusa.action_03b6.input: Automatic final slam after the Izuna airborne loop.
jin_hayabusa.action_03b6.description: Internal paired landing/slam; not an independently selectable move.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c71.input: Use the assigned source in its stance; Frost Moon also accepts its Ki Pulse stance-switch gesture.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c71.description: Jin's Flying Swallow opener with three authored continuation phases.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c72.input: Automatic second phase after Flying Swallow opens.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c72.description: Flying Swallow continuation phase two; this tuning value affects only this phase.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c73.input: Automatic third phase after Flying Swallow continues.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c74.input: Automatic final phase after Flying Swallow continues.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c74.description: Flying Swallow ending and recovery phase.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c81.input: Use the assigned source in its stance; two airborne phases follow.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c81.description: Jin's aerial somersault opener and its authored airborne continuation.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c82.input: Automatic second phase after the aerial somersault opener.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c83.input: Automatic final phase after aerial somersault phase two.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c83.description: Aerial somersault ending and recovery phase.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c75.input: Use the assigned source in its stance; Frost Moon can also trigger it during the matching Ki Pulse window.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c75.description: Jin's downward sword slash route with release preparation and final strike.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c77.input: Automatic release preparation after the downward slash opener.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c77.description: Preparation phase before Jin's downward strike; tune separately from the final hit.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c78.input: Automatic strike after downward slash release preparation.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c78.description: Final downward slash and landing recovery phase.

jin_hayabusa.flying_swallow_jump.input: Use the assigned native or custom input in its selected stance.
jin_hayabusa.flying_swallow_jump.description: Single Flying Swallow jump entry; unlike the four-phase route, this selects its jump action only.

jin_hayabusa.action_0bbf.input: Use the assigned source in its stance; four quick strikes follow this opener.
jin_hayabusa.action_0bbf.description: Opening attack of Jin's five-strike quick sword string.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c63.input: Automatic second attack in Jin's five-strike quick string.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c63.description: Second quick-string phase; source naming is inferred from recorded order.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c64.input: Automatic third attack in Jin's five-strike quick string.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c64.description: Third quick-string phase; tune this strike separately from the opener.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c65.input: Automatic fourth attack in Jin's five-strike quick string.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c65.description: Fourth quick-string phase before the finisher.

jin_hayabusa.action_0c66.input: Automatic fifth attack in Jin's five-strike quick string.
jin_hayabusa.action_0c66.description: Final quick-string strike and recovery phase.

oda_nobunaga.action_0c6e.input: Use the assigned source in its stance; Frost Moon requires its Ki Pulse stance-switch gesture.
oda_nobunaga.action_0c6e.description: First of Oda's final two slashes; the second follows as an authored continuation.

oda_nobunaga.action_0c6f.input: Automatic second slash after Oda's two-hit route opens.
oda_nobunaga.action_0c6f.description: Oda's final slash. Its speed can be tuned separately from the opener.

sanada_yukimura.action_0c6a.input: Use the assigned source in its stance; the preset places this on a short Guard/LB + Aim/LT tap.
sanada_yukimura.action_0c6a.description: bloodborne gun shot. Projectile assets and temporary sword hiding belong to this route.

tachibana_muneshige.action_0d8d.input: Use the assigned source in its stance; the preset puts it after a High heavy with Guard/LB + Quick/Square/X.
tachibana_muneshige.action_0d8d.description: Tachibana's Omnislice/Quadrisect adaptation; Ki Pulse and recovery must follow William's route.

toyotomi_hideyori.action_0d30.input: Use the assigned source in its stance; the preset uses Low Quick/Square/X.
toyotomi_hideyori.action_0d30.description: Hideyori's four-hit sword string opener; the remaining three hits follow its graph.

toyotomi_hideyori.action_0d31.input: Automatic second hit after Hideyori's four-hit opener.
toyotomi_hideyori.action_0d31.description: Second strike of Hideyori's quick string; William's Ki cost remains separately authored.

toyotomi_hideyori.action_0d32.input: Automatic third hit after Hideyori's second strike.
toyotomi_hideyori.action_0d32.description: Third strike of Hideyori's four-hit quick string.

toyotomi_hideyori.action_0d33.input: Automatic fourth hit after Hideyori's third strike.
toyotomi_hideyori.action_0d33.description: Final strike and exit of Hideyori's four-hit quick string.
